name: patent-cli
description: Fast Go-native patent lookup for Claude Desktop. Single binary, no runtime dependencies — significantly faster MCP responses than Node/Python-based alternatives. Fetches title, abstract, claims, assignee, legal status, and figures from Google Patents.

tools.name: patent_lookup
tools.description: Fetch complete patent details by patent number (title, abstract, claims, assignee, legal status, figures)

tools.name: patent_fields
tools.description: List all available fields for patent_lookup
